answer: Cluster answers by authorship signature, since one operator's personas correlate. Score each identity's submissions by style, timing and n-gram fingerprints; honest agents scatter across a tundra, but a farm's fakes — one author — pack a tight cluster, an ivory seam of near-identical tells. Flag low-diversity clusters co-submitting in lockstep from one vault of latent style. A soft signal feeding the non-kin quorum and audit draw, never a standalone payout gate — a genuinely similar honest pair costs nothing; only an improbably uniform swarm is down-weighted.
